reviews.text: I didn't actually dine in but had take put twice during my stay at Edinburgh. Great vegan options. The vegan chicken katsu curry was simply the best. The pumpkin fritters and vegan hell ramen were also quite tasty. Definitely recommend if you're looking for vegan Japanese.

reviews.text: Very small area. I had the Ramen noodle bowl soup. I didn’t care for my meal. Kind of bland. Now my husband had the Teriyaki chicken meal and food was great.

reviews.author: Leeann Cockburn
reviews.text: Absolutely love this place every day of the week and is always my number 1 go-to for office lunch when not WFH. Brought my 2 kids and fiance to try; fiance should have been a chef because he is class, my kids will eat relatively well but sometimes need to be forced this was different! Both LOVED the katsu curry and we adults thoroughly enjoyed the spicy Ramen, my fiance asked for as spicy as possible and asked for 4 extra portions of the chilli crisp. We were not disappointed! Every single ingredient sings and the heat in the Ramen isnt front facing aggressive heat, it's layered. The kids absolutely loved the gong and when staff noticed they were dying for a shot (we were sitting right next to it 🙃🤣) they couldn't have been nicer to them even though the restaurant was MOBBED! A lovely member of staff also complimented on their manners and how respectful and well behaved they were they and that not all kids are like that, which we were so proud to hear 🫶 best all round!

reviews.author: Happy Travel
reviews.text: We went to Maki & Ramen at St James Quarter for dinner and initially thought we might have quite a wait, as there were around six or seven parties ahead of us. Surprisingly, the queue moved quickly and we were seated in about 10 minutes. We tried a few different ramen bowls; the broths were rich without being too heavy. I’d especially recommend the takoyaki and Tonkotsu Ramen as I like pork belly charsiu. The seating is fairly compact, so it feels more like a casual eat-and-go place than somewhere for a long, relaxed dinner.

reviews.author: Lucy-Ella Jones
reviews.text: Me and my partner visited here in 2025 when it first opened, we returned a year later. Both times we have been really happy, their menu has a lot of options and everything tastes great. Staff are friendly the first time we attended we got sticky notes to draw on and stick to the wall, sadly we forgot to check if our drawings were still there a year later 😅. I have lactose intolerance and am vegetarian, therefore I tend to order vegan items so I know they are safe. Was a little sad the miso broth with tofu ramen as far as I could see was not there. But they still have a lot of items that make me feel like I am not missing out as much with my diet restrictions.

reviews.text: Maki & Ramen has a lovely atmosphere and a welcoming feel. The service was friendly and attentive, and the overall experience was smooth and enjoyable. A great place to relax, enjoy some good food, and spend time with friends. I’d happily come back again!

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.text: I’ve been to this restaurant in other cities and this was by far the worst of them all. I usually like this place because of their good food but the service today was terrible. We were served by Mia W, I don’t know if she was special needs or just really bad at her job but she got our order wrong about 4 times, we were brought the wrong drink, when we asked her for a food item ON THE MENU whilst pointing at it so she could see what we wanted - she looked incredibly confused as if she’d never heard of the food before, and every time we spoke to her she stared at us very rudely with her mouth wide open like we were speaking a different language and we often had to repeat ourselves whenever we spoke to her (we all have regular British accents and the other workers there understood us perfectly fine). The sushi also took over an hour to arrive after we ordered it, which I don’t blame her for because obviously there’s nothing she could do about that. When we finished our food, we asked Mia for the bill and for a box to pack the rest of the sushi so we could take it home, she said okay and came back with the card machine and no box. We then showed her our Maki & Ramen loyalty card for her to scan, and she just looked at us with her mouth wide open and said “we don’t do student discounts”. so we said “this isn’t a student id, it’s a loyalty card for this restaurant” and she just stared at us for 5 minutes and said she needs to get her manager to do this. She then returned with her manager (still no box) and the manager scanned the card with no problems. We then asked her for a box again and she looked even more confused then we had to clarify (for the 3rd time) that we wanted a box for our food and then she finally gave us a box. Overall, the food was alright but the server was rude and not very good at taking orders.

Unfortunately, the prawn tempura was probably the worst I’ve ever had—it wasn’t crispy at all, and the batter was extremely thick. The waiting time was also far too long. Even though there were plenty of empty tables inside, we were still kept waiting at the door for ages. Surprisingly, such a large restaurant only had two members of staff working during the busy dinner rush. That being said, they both provided great service.

reviews.text: The place is very nice, nice decorations, nice lighting, nice music at a decent volume. The staff was very friendly. I had the vegetarian ramen and it was good but not the best. The broth was really tasty and the boiled egg was delicious. And everything was cooked perfectly. But the noodles were nothing special and it said that it had vegan bacon but it was fried tofu instead, which was very soft and it had a very strong taste of tofu, which I normally like but this one was too strong, almost like fresh paint from a wall!! (Ok, maybe not that much, but almost) But the egg was amaazing! (Again!!) But don't get me wrong, I would probably come again, just for the egg!!

reviews.author: Becky Easter
reviews.text: Stumbled upon Maki and Ramen after a disappointing visit to our usual Wagamamas and we were pleasantly surprised! So many vegan options and clearly labelled too! Such a clear and informative menu. Table service is via QR code, which is the only negative really, you lose out on human connection. But the food came quickly and efficiently. We ordered the black garlic bowl, with extra tofu, which was great! We added extra tofu to go along with the vegan bacon but at no point were we told there was no vegan bacon so we spent £3.50 on the extra tofu but only got tofu in the bowl... The food was great and value for money. Definitely be returning! (In fact less than 48hours later, my friend is back there with another friend😅)

reviews.author: Jade Friend
reviews.text: Firstly we had to wait a while even though there was loads of empty seats. Look ages to get served, even though there was multiple staff. The food took a while and was not great, It was pretty bland and needed something else. My drink wasn’t too bad but my friends lychee lemonade was ridiculously sweet. When I asked for the bill I also said I had a tastecard code. The guy decided to tell me I should’ve booked to let them know.. I hadn’t had a problem before, plus some places say it on the app, this one didn’t. He never even brought me the bill and decided to keep serving other people. Which I found very rude, I just wanted to leave it was loud from the staff shouting and super hot. I didn’t get the guys name but he was a tall white guy that look like he’d been in a fight all busted up. I had to get someone else to get me the bill. I should’ve refused service charge. Also the toilets were absolutely disgusting. Stunk, tissue everywhere, poo splattered up toilets. Liked like the place was falling apart. There was even a railing coming off the way wall we moved as we went up the stairs. We didn’t notice until my friend grabbed on and almost fell from it coming away. Would not recommend and certainly will not be going back.

reviews.author: Itai Moses (‫אתי‬‎)
reviews.text: We came here as it was half price for food on first table. Glad that we did not pay full price, and not even sure it was worth it with half price off. We got edamame which were clearly heated from frozen, veg gyozas were okay. Veg ramen was okay, the broth was decent but it was mainly just noodles, no veggies or extras. The tofu was meant to be fried tofu but was just soft and plain. Fried chicken was fatty and poor quality meat, cooked from frozen and seemed to be undercooked. Same issue with chicken soba. Boba was nice but served with a tiny straw so you couldn’t even drink it properly! Think based on the reviews this is a tourist trap, but you can get far better quality ramen in London for the price.

reviews.author: Liuchang MA
reviews.text: Really disappointing experience. Both bowls of ramen were incredibly salty, and the black garlic oil ramen was overwhelmingly greasy with barely any aroma or flavour. Honestly, it just wasn’t enjoyable to eat. Service wasn’t much better — the table was sticky and we waited ages just to pay the bill. Such a shame, as my first visit here was completely different and I really enjoyed it then.

reviews.author: James Tester
reviews.text: Appalling slow and clueless service, eating implements, glasses, water drinks etc all had to be asked for multiple times after being ‘ignored’ for over half an hour. When food finally came the ramen soup dishes we ordered were not the quality of ramen we expect (eating ramen in restaurants many many times). On the plus side the maki rolls were good. We had a 50% discount code which tempered the disappointment, but had we paid full price I might be leaving a somewhat more scathing review.

reviews.author: Nat Harris
reviews.text: Thank you Ren for being so accommodating and lovely! Dynamite prawns were a proper highlight ✨ My only thing that I'd love to see improved is the legibility of the menus because the lighting made it hard to read but everything else was great

reviews.author: Sophia Donald
reviews.text: Cute new place. Wonderful service by Navin.

reviews.author: Matthew Cane
reviews.text: Our server Lesley was very smiley and my tiger roll was absolutely banging. Excellent 👌

reviews.author: Franciscus Prins
reviews.text: Had a wonderful meal here. The ramen was excellent as was the gyoza. Lesley was a great server and we will be back! P.s. enjoy the drum on your way in.

reviews.author: Matthew Ysart
reviews.text: Navin very attentive

reviews.author: Alan Reid
reviews.text: Greasy and lukewarm yaki soba. Warm broth. Mediocre ramen.

reviews.author: Melanie Ngai
reviews.text: I have been to this restaurant twice, with 1 week apart. Both times the service was good. Navin stood out in service, very helpful and friendly. On my first visit, the food was disappointing. The Steak Tataki Raman had 4 thin small slices of steak and they were well done not rare, so a little chewy. The sushi rice in the volcano roll and soft shell crab roll was over cooked, they were like sticky rice, not nice at all. 2nd visit, the sushi rolls rice was as expected. We really enjoyed our food in our 2nd visit. The chef must had an off day on our 1st visit.

reviews.author: Amman Meah
reviews.text: My server Navin was great, sashimi was good, tempura squid tasted like rubber. Mainly annoyed about the fact their bookings started from 3:45, I booked a table for 4pm the day before, arrived, and the restaurant was closed. Terrible work from them to accept bookings when they’re not even open.

reviews.author: Yuri Damasceno
reviews.text: The food was delicious and in generous portions, the service was thoughtful and quick. Very worth a visit.

reviews.author: Kaotar
reviews.text: Super friendly staff and loved the dynamite prawns!

reviews.author: Maryam Hamid
reviews.text: Great food Mia was amazing and really helpful would definitely recommend!!

reviews.author: Kishor Joshi
reviews.text: Great service and delicious food.

reviews.author: Angela Carroll
reviews.text: Food was delicious, particularly enjoyed the dynamite prawns!!! Staff and atmosphere were lovely! Will definately be returning!

reviews.author: Rhiannon Powell
reviews.text: Love the food at this place!

reviews.author: Kuba Czekaj
reviews.text: Great place for families with kids . Great workers, even tho we were slightly weary as they are all very young . We were treated like royalty which was brilliant. The manager that runs the place ( Kaitlin ) is also great, she was there ready to guide us through the menu like a pro . I’d highly recommend visiting for a great Japanese cuisine.

reviews.author: marcelina Madusiok
reviews.text: We have visited Maki and Ramen for a dinner with our picky children . It was great experience for both us and kids ( they left absolutely stuffed) . We then were introduced to the general manager Kaitlin which was great, she’s extremely knowledgeable and she definitely knows her stuff and you can clearly see how dedicated she is. She has explained all of the dishes to us as we had no experience in this kind of food . Overall we had great time and will be revisiting very soon ! 10/10

reviews.author: Vishaly Wimal
reviews.text: really great food, good portions (had to take some home!)

reviews.author: Sarah Warren
reviews.text: Lovely experience today at Mali and Ramen . Fantastic decor, really friendly and speedy service! Food was just delicious. Will definitely be coming back!!

reviews.author: Grace Adams
reviews.text: was so so so tasty and lovely staff

reviews.author: Luke Morris
reviews.text: Really nice place with excellent food and service! Very authentic experience, big fan of the drum.

reviews.author: Ofra
reviews.text: Just ate here. Fish is not fresh. Some of the worst sushi I’ve ever had. Staff made multiple mistakes on our order. Handed me cutlery that they had fingered all over the side you eat with. Had to ask multiple times for a teaspoon and bowl for my child and was forgotten by three Separate staff members. My bill was wrong and overcharged. The waitress tried to get me to get the lunchtime deal when it came time to pay, but I pointed out to her that that would actually cost me more. Manager asked me if everything was okay, I explained to him our experience, And I got nothing but an apology and “hope to see you next time”. Staff need extra training for sure. Do not eat here, you’re better off going to the High Street for sushi or even yo sushi.

reviews.author: F P
reviews.text: We came as a group to celebrate a friend’s birthday, and we had an absolutely amazing time! From start to finish, everything was fantastic. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was brilliant, and the service was truly on point. A special shout-out and huge thank you to Felicia, who was incredibly friendly, attentive and welcoming throughout the evening. She went above and beyond to make sure we were well looked after and really helped make the night extra special. We couldn’t have asked for a better place to celebrate. We had such a wonderful evening and will definitely be coming back!

reviews.author: Anjali SK
reviews.text: Good service good place

reviews.author: Phoebe Grankin
reviews.text: Amazing food, service and atmosphere! Had a great time with my friend, great service Vika and Nicky!

reviews.author: km a
reviews.text: Felicia was very helpful and cheerful. She helped us in deciding food. Atmosphere and food was awesome 👍.keep it up 😋

reviews.author: Sandy Cross
reviews.text: Felisha is wonderful 💯😊

reviews.author: Ayesha Aden
reviews.text: Best service ever made by Viktoria she made us feel so comfortable and made the service ever best for us all of u guys should come here and be serve by her 💞

reviews.author: Sabrin Mohamud
reviews.text: The service are soo nice and kind and the food was 10/10

reviews.author: Armita
reviews.text: Great service, friendly staff and lovely food. Felicia W. Was our server and she's such a lovely lady. She's so friendly and hardworking and really made us feel welcomed. Very happy

reviews.author: Ali Khan
reviews.text: Nicky and Mia were great and very attentive

reviews.author: Arya Ghafuri
reviews.text: Nikki was very lovely!

reviews.author: Khadiza
reviews.text: Nice place, good service, Nicky and Felicia were very helpful and pleasant

reviews.author: Fajar Ikhlaq
reviews.text: The staff here is amazing. They make the experience 10 times better.

reviews.author: Lib
reviews.text: Was a bit disappointed with how the food was. Ordered a chicken firecracker ramen and steak ramen and with the chicken one being 16 pound it had only about 3 pieces of chicken in it and not much flavor. Steak was somewhat better as it came with more portion of steak. Initially our server told us they were out of steak ramen and we were going to leave but then another staff member said they did have it and fixed our order for us so that atleast worked out. Overall it’s a nice built restaurant but the prices don’t match the quality of the food at all. They should also communicate that the 5 pound ramen is only one per table as it’s providing false advertisement thinking both people can get ramen for 5 pound.

reviews.author: Andy Miles
reviews.text: Was totally ignored by serving staff for twenty minutes and left. Won't be returning.

reviews.author: mina
reviews.text: Unfortunately, we were disappointed with our experience at Maki & Ramen Birmingham. We waited around an hour for our food, and only half the order arrived initially. We had to ask for the rest of our food and drinks, then waited ages again to pay and leave. I’ve never experienced such a bad service before. The music was also far too loud and overstimulating. The food was okay overall, with the sushi being the highlight, but the noodle broth arrived lukewarm. Overall, the slow service and atmosphere really took away from what could have been a much better experience I’ve experienced at other branches. And I hope there’s improvement as it goes on.

reviews.author: Rex Lapis
reviews.text: waited for 1 hour and had to ask the servers when the food would arrive. Turns out they ran out of an ingredient which the chef did not communicate to the servers and we had to place an order again. was given a £20 coupon as compensation but this will probably be used for one per table as they do this with the £5 coupons. Better to go alone

reviews.author: cherryq
reviews.text: Came here with my friends and was planning to use our £5 coupons. Turned out we couldn’t use more than one coupon for one table so ordered anyways. We ordered our food, waited for over an hour and still didn’t get our food. One item on the menu was had ran out and no staff were notified so we ended up waiting for nothing. Absolutely no communication between any of the staff in the kitchen and taking orders. We left without our food and was offered coupons, which they had ready probably because this has happened more than once. Felt completely ignored and I won’t be coming here again.

reviews.author: S Ma
reviews.text: Disappointed that only selected dishes were available at a weekend lunchtime. Table wasn’t clean even though they had just opened for service. Service was however friendly, quick and efficient. Food was ok but not all advertised ingredients were included (e.g ramen dish seemed to be missing spring onion and bamboo).

reviews.author: Olivia Lewis
reviews.text: Visiting London and stopped in for lunch, absolutely great food, atmosphere, and phenomenal service. Our group ordered handrolls, the chefs special, crudo, and the cucumber salad, all were amazing. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable and gave great recommendations. Would absolutely come back soon!!

reviews.author: Willy Narby
reviews.text: Had the best time, the hand rolls are some of the best I’ve ever had

reviews.author: Judyarr W
reviews.text: We had such an enjoyable Japanese dining experience at Maki Nori in Soho. Everything was beautifully presented, fresh and full of flavour. I especially loved the snow crab hand roll, the crispy nori made it so satisfying! Watching the A5 Wagyu nigiri being seared at our table was another highlight. Paired the 15 pieces omakase with sake. The homemade plum wine was a lovely way to finish the meal. Definitely a Soho spot I would recommend to Japanese food lovers.

reviews.author: Jolin
reviews.text: Had such a lovely experience here! The manager, Jade, was incredibly welcoming and friendly, and really made us feel looked after throughout the meal. All the staff were very attentive and patient, and they took the time to explain each dish to us, which I really appreciated as there were quite a few things we hadn’t tried before. The food was fresh and beautifully presented, but honestly, the service was what really stood out to me. Everyone was so warm and helpful without being overbearing. Would definitely come back again, especially for the great service. 😊

reviews.author: Josh Bilbe
reviews.text: Not that great. The quality of the fish wasn't amazing and that and the price wasn't up-to-par with other sushi restaurants in the area.

reviews.author: Roberto James
reviews.text: There is not a better sushi spot in London better than maki nori, the quality of food is unmatched, the atmosphere is relaxing and the chefs are the best

reviews.author: Mr Rd
reviews.text: I love everything about this place I lived in Japan for 6years and honestly couldn't tell the difference between the food here and back there Definitely new favorite dinner spot for me and my family I want to say special thank you to Jada, she was super attentive and friendly

reviews.author: Matt Morris
reviews.text: Best Japanese we’ve had in London. The food was fantastic and very reasonably priced. The yuzu sour was excellent as well. The service from Hsu Y was friendly and so quick. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Stephen
reviews.text: Loved it, very quick service and fresh food. However it's extremely bright, which is great and different - but I think the lighting could be a little sexier!
